title: Junta restriction sample count
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $M$ and a failure parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$, define the sample count to be $2^{k+1}M$ plus the Fourier-estimator sample count at accuracy equal to the junta-restriction match accuracy for $k$, with failure parameter $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: the failure parameter is rational and satisfies $0<\delta\leq 1/2$
caveat: The formal statement uses the named match-accuracy and Fourier-estimator sample-count functions, whose definitions are not included in the payload.
